'''Itsuhayahime-no-Mikoto''' (伊都速比売命) is a {{ill|Goddess|en|Goddess|qid=Q205985|lt=goddess}} from the {{ill|Suwa Shrine|ja|諏訪信仰|lt=Suwa faith}} in the {{ill|Suwa Region|ja|諏訪地方|lt=Suwa region}} of present-day {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Nagano|af|Nagano-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Nagano|ar|ناغانو (محافظة)|arz|محافظه ناجانو|az|Naqano prefekturası|azb|ناقانو اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Nagano|be|Нагана (прэфектура)|bg|Нагано|bn|নাগানো প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Nagano|cdo|Nagano-gâing|ce|Нагано (префектура)|ceb|Nagano-ken|ckb|پارێزگای ناگانۆ|cs|Prefektura Nagano|cy|Nagano (talaith)|da|Nagano-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Nagano|eo|Gubernio Nagano|es|Prefectura de Nagano|et|Nagano prefektuur|eu|Nagano (prefektura)|fa|استان ناگانو|fi|Naganon prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Nagano|frr|Nagano (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Nagano|gl|Prefectura de Nagano|hak|Nagano-yen|he|נאגנו (מחוז)|hr|Nagano (prefektura)|hu|Nagano prefektúra|hy|Նագանո (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Nagano|ilo|Prepektura ti Nagano|it|Prefettura di Nagano|ja|長野県|ka|ნაგანოს პრეფექტურა|kaa|Nagano prefekturası|kn|ನಾಗನೊ (ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯ)|ko|나가노현|la|Naganoënsis|lt|Nagano prefektūra|lv|Nagano prefektūra|mk|Нагано (префектура)|mni|ꯅꯥꯒꯥꯅꯣ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|नागानो प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Nagano|ne|नगानो|nl|Nagano (prefectuur)|no|Nagano (prefektur)|nov|Nagano Prefekture|os|Нагано (префектурæ)|pam|Prepektura ning Nagano|pl|Prefektura Nagano|pnb|ضلع ناگانو|pt|Nagano|ro|Prefectura Nagano|ru|Нагано (префектура)|sco|Nagano Prefectur|se|Nagano prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Nagano|si|නගානො ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Nagano Prefecture|sk|Nagano (prefektúra)|sl|Prefektura Nagano|sr|Префектура Нагано|su|Nagano Prefecture|sv|Nagano prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Nagano|tg|Префектураи Нагано|th|จังหวัดนางาโนะ|tl|Prepektura ng Nagano|tr|Nagano (prefektörlük)|tt|Нагано (префектура)|uk|Нагано (префектура)|ur|ناگانو پریفیکچر|vi|Nagano|war|Nagano (prefektura)|wuu|长野县|zh|长野县|zh_classical|長野縣|zh_min_nan|Nagano-koān|zh_yue|長野縣|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture}}.

== Overview ==
Itsuhayahime-no-Mikoto, also written as Izuhayahime-no-Mikoto, is considered synonymous with {{ill|Aizu-hime-no-Kami|ja|会津比売神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aizuhime-no-Kami|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q56350355}}.<ref>Yonekawa Kazuhiko, *Shuho Suwa-keizu* (修補諏訪氏系図), Taisho 10 (1921), p. 23.</ref> She is the daughter of {{ill|Izuhayao-no-Mikoto|ja|出早雄命}}
, one of the offspring of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}}, and is considered a deity unique to Suwa. The deity {{ill|Itsuhayahime-no-Mikoto|ja|伊志波夜比売命|lt=Ishihayahime-no-Mikoto}}, worshipped at {{ill|Ame-no-Murakumo Ijihayahime Shrine|ja|天村雲伊自波夜比売神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Murakumo Ijihayahime Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579268}}, a {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} in the former {{ill|Awa Province (Tokushima)|en|Awa Province (Tokushima)|qid=Q907457|lt=Awa Province}}, is said to be the same entity. *Dai Nihon Jinjishi* identifies her as the daughter of Izuhayao-no-Mikoto and the consort of {{ill|Ame no Murakumo|ja|天村雲命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Murakumo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q91088537}}.<ref name="#1">Yonekawa Kazuhiko, *Shuho Suwa-keizu*, pp. 23-24.</ref>

In *Shuho Suwa-keizu*, it is concluded that Itsuhayahime-no-Mikoto and Ishihayahime-no-Mikoto are indeed the same deity. The work also discusses the possibility of her marriage being an extension of the ties between {{ill|Koshi Province (Japan)|ja|高志国|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koshinokuni|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 越国|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1351611}} and {{ill|Shinano Province|en|Shinano Province|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}.<ref name="#1"/>

== Genealogy ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|170px|thumbnail|center|{{ill|The Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}}'s first five generations<br />(from Moriya to Yatsukushi-no-Kami)]]
She is one of the daughters of {{ill|Izuhayao-no-Mikoto|ja|出早雄命}}
, a child of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}} and {{ill|Yasakatome|en|Yasakatome|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome-no-Kami}}. Her mother is {{ill|Tamaru-hime|ja|多満留姫}}, daughter of {{ill|Moreya|en|Moreya|qid=Q11146526|lt=Moriya}}.<ref>*History of Moreya Shrine* (2017), accessed August 17, 2017.</ref> She has siblings such as {{ill|Kamoha no Kami|ja|可毛羽神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamohane-no-Kami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135493216}}, {{ill|Wakakihime-no-Kami|ja|若木比売神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakakihime-no-Kami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135492776}}, {{ill|Kusanoi-hime|ja|草奈井比売神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kusanai-no-Kami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135493035}}, and {{ill|Sawaetahara-Rokurohiko-no-Kami|ja|佐和恵多良六老彦神|qid=Q140446116}}.

The *Dai Nihon Jinjishi* describes her as the consort of {{ill|Ame no Murakumo|ja|天村雲命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Murakumo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q91088537}}.
